mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM SMT_STAFF WHERE ID IN #{id} ORDER BY ID FOR UPDATE
SELECT ID FROM SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY WHERE ID IN ORDER BY ID FOR UPDATE

SELECT SUM(N) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) N FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE WHERE SOURCE_KIND='STAFF_AUTH' AND SUBJECT_TYPE='STAFF' AND STATE!='CONVERGED' AND SUBJECT_ID IN UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) N FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_COORD WHERE SUBJECT_TYPE='STAFF' AND STATE NOT IN ('ACTIVE','TOMBSTONE') AND SUBJECT_ID IN )

SELECT CARD_NO SUBJECT_ID,'MISSING_DEVICE_HISTORY:'||ACCESS_TYPE||':TASK='||TO_CHAR(MIN(ID))||':COUNT='||TO_CHAR(COUNT(*)) VERIFICATION_REASON FROM ( SELECT T.ID,T.CARD_NO,'DIRECT' ACCESS_TYPE FROM SMT_DEVICE_TASK T LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE D ON D.ID=T.DEVICE_CODE WHERE T.DEVICE_TYPE=#{cardDeviceType} AND T.SERVICE_TYPE IN (#{employeeService},#{faceUpdateService}) AND T.CARD_NO IN AND (D.ID IS NULL OR D.PARK_ID IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT T.ID,T.CARD_NO,'ISC' ACCESS_TYPE FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK T LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE D ON D.ID=T.DEVICE_CODE WHERE T.DEVICE_TYPE=#{cardDeviceType} AND T.SERVICE_TYPE IN (#{employeeService},#{faceUpdateService}) AND T.CARD_NO IN AND (D.ID IS NULL OR D.PARK_ID IS NULL) ) GROUP BY CARD_NO,ACCESS_TYPE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE WHERE SOURCE_KIND='STAFF_AUTH' AND SUBJECT_TYPE='STAFF' AND PARK_ID=#{park} AND SUBJECT_ID=#{subject} AND STATE!='CONVERGED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE WHERE SOURCE_KIND='STAFF_AUTH' AND SUBJECT_TYPE='STAFF' AND PARK_ID=#{park} AND SUBJECT_ID=#{subject} AND AUTH_ID=#{authId} AND STATE!='CONVERGED'
mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE WHERE OPERATION_KEY=#{key} ORDER BY PARK_ID,ORDINAL
SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE WHERE BATCH_ID=#{batch} AND ORDINAL=#{ordinal}
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_RESOURCE WHERE BATCH_ID=#{batch} AND ORDINAL>#{after} ORDER BY ORDINAL) WHERE ROWNUM<=#{limit}

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE SET SOURCE_COORD_ID=#{source}, SOURCE_GENERATION=#{generation} WHERE BATCH_ID=#{batch} AND ORDINAL=#{ordinal} AND (SOURCE_COORD_ID IS NULL OR (SOURCE_COORD_ID=#{source} AND SOURCE_GENERATION=#{generation}))
UPDATE SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_RESOURCE SET RESOURCE_COORD_ID=#{resource} WHERE BATCH_ID=#{batch} AND ORDINAL=#{ordinal} AND (RESOURCE_COORD_ID IS NULL OR RESOURCE_COORD_ID=#{resource})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_RESOURCE WHERE BATCH_ID=#{batch}
SELECT EXPANSION_CURSOR FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH WHERE ID=#{batch}
SELECT COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN RESOURCE_COORD_ID IS NULL THEN ORDINAL END)-1,MAX(ORDINAL),0) FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_RESOURCE WHERE BATCH_ID=#{batch}
SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE WHERE SOURCE_COORD_ID=#{source} AND SOURCE_GENERATION=#{generation}

NVL(#{s.sourceKind,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'STAFF_AUTH')='STAFF_AUTH' AND NVL(#{s.subjectType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'STAFF')='STAFF' AND NVL(#{s.snapshotVersion,jdbcType=NUMERIC},0)=0 AND ID=#{s.oldId} AND STAFF_ID=#{s.subjectId} AND AUTH_ID=#{s.authId} AND ((CREATE_TIME=#{s.oldCreateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) OR (CREATE_TIME IS NULL AND #{s.oldCreateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL)) AND ((START_TIME=#{s.oldStartTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) OR (START_TIME IS NULL AND #{s.oldStartTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL)) AND ((END_TIME=#{s.oldEndTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) OR (END_TIME IS NULL AND #{s.oldEndTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL)) AND ((AUTH_TYPE=#{s.oldAuthType,jdbcType=NUMERIC}) OR (AUTH_TYPE IS NULL AND #{s.oldAuthType,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SMT_STAFF_DEVICE_AUTH(STAFF_ID,AUTH_ID,CREATE_TIME,START_TIME,END_TIME,AUTH_TYPE) SELECT #{s.subjectId},#{s.authId},#{s.newCreateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},#{s.newStartTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},#{s.newEndTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},#{s.newAuthType,jdbcType=NUMERIC} FROM DUAL WHERE NVL(#{s.sourceKind,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'STAFF_AUTH')='STAFF_AUTH' AND NVL(#{s.subjectType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'STAFF')='STAFF' AND NVL(#{s.snapshotVersion,jdbcType=NUMERIC},0)=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY A WHERE A.ID=#{s.authId} AND A.PARK_ID=#{s.parkId}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_STAFF_DEVICE_AUTH WHERE STAFF_ID=#{s.subjectId} AND AUTH_ID=#{s.authId})

SELECT S.* FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE S WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C WHERE C.TARGET_ID=#{targetId} AND C.SOURCE_COORD_ID=S.SOURCE_COORD_ID AND C.SOURCE_GENERATION=S.SOURCE_GENERATION) ORDER BY S.BATCH_ID,S.ORDINAL
